description: Documentation and guide on extending torch.autograd.Function with torch.func transforms, including usage, examples, limitations, and support for vmap and jvp.

classes.name: torch.autograd.Function
classes.description: Base class for defining custom autograd operations with support for extended static methods like vmap and jvp.

methods.name: setup_context
methods.description: Method to modify the context object during the setup phase of a custom autograd.Function, used for saving tensors and non-tensors for backward.

methods.name: backward
methods.description: Method to define the gradient computation for the custom autograd.Function, supporting higher-order gradients.

methods.name: vmap
methods.description: Static method to define how the function behaves under torch.vmap, enabling batched operations.

methods.name: jvp
methods.description: Static method to support forward-mode automatic differentiation (JVP) for the custom autograd.Function.
